description: This file contains the implementation of a Reward class in the OpenCart platform, specifically within the extension's Total controller namespace. It provides functionalities such as displaying reward points and saving reward point adjustments, indicating its role in managing customer reward points in the cart or checkout process.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Class handling reward points display and adjustment in the order process, extending the base Controller class of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the current reward points information and interface if the reward system is enabled.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the reward points allocated by the user, including validation and session updates.
